svg.title: K05: the Service forwards to the wrong container port
svg.desc: The visitor calls the Service draw on port 80. The Service forwards to targetPort 8080, but the Excalidraw container listens on port 80, so the connection is refused even though the endpoints exist. The fix is targetPort 80.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: port is the Service front door; targetPort is the door on the container

svg.text: The Pod is fine and the endpoint list is full. The address it points to has the wrong port.

svg.text: Endpoints exist, the Pod is Ready, still: connection refused. Test layer by layer (Pod IP, then Service).

svg.text: Set targetPort: 80, the port the container really listens on.
